02 / ORBIT

A curiosity with no borders.

Different subjects, one shared instinct: understand the system, test the rules, then build something with them.

The same question connects a planet, a drone, and a chess piece: where can it go next?

I’m a student below matric level, learning through practical experiments. I like problems that reward patience — simulating movement, shaping 3D worlds, writing game logic, and finding the clean route through a puzzle.
